scope: Refresh the proven H0.0 control-only scaffold onto current canonical main, preserve the historical R1 execution ledger unchanged, complete phase-independent active-Work-Order evidence isolation, and re-prove the H0_0_SCAFFOLD_READY predicates without creating or modifying runtime scope.
required_outputs: Current-main H0.0 scaffold with the historical R1 execution ledger retained as evidence only
Phase-independent active Work Order evidence/review isolation
Fresh Evidence Map and post-build critique
Independent Reviewer PASS and Verifier PASS
stop_conditions: Any gameplay/runtime/domain path would need to change
Any canonical harness schema or checkpoint contract would need to change
Historical E2026-08-11-H0-0-R1 execution records would need mutation
Current main moves away from the epoch base before checkpoint proposal
PC0 has an unresolved blocking RED after advisory research semantics are applied
A blocking Human Attention decision is required
risk_reasons: The scaffold reconstructs authorization state from immutable evidence and review records.
Incorrect historical/active Work Order partitioning could reuse stale PASS evidence.
The refresh must preserve current-main control semantics while transferring only control-only capability from historical H0 work.

design_brief.problem_statement: The prior H0.0 implementation and evidence were created from main 790fd79f, while canonical main is now 40c117bb after project-control and ECO advisory-control changes. Continuing the old Project Epoch would violate epoch freshness.
design_brief.current_behavior: The historical control/h0-closed-loop-development branch contains useful scaffold implementation and evidence, but its active epoch base is stale and its latest Work Order is BLOCKED.
design_brief.desired_behavior: A fresh current-main H0.0 branch owns a new Project Epoch, transfers only the already-reviewed control scaffold capability, completes phase-independent evidence isolation, and re-verifies every H0.0 predicate against the fresh base.
alternatives_considered: Continue the old epoch despite main movement.
Merge the entire historical branch including its execution ledger into the fresh branch.
Create a fresh current-main epoch and selectively transfer only current H0 scaffold capability while keeping R1 as immutable historical evidence.
design_brief.selected_design: Create E2026-08-11-H0-0-R2 at exact current main, use a new bounded Work Order, preserve E2026-08-11-H0-0-R1 unchanged, and transfer only control-only scaffold implementation/tests required by H0_0_SCAFFOLD_READY.
design_brief.why_selected: This preserves restart-safe epoch semantics, avoids stale evidence authorization, keeps historical forensic value, and prevents unrelated ECO research movement from blocking H0 while retaining normal control gates.
dependencies: PC0 advisory research semantics merged by PR #71
non_goals: No rewrite of historical H0 R1 events
expected_risks: Accidentally copying historical authorization evidence into the active R2 epoch
Dropping a needed scaffold fix while transferring files
Tests passing because of historical documents rather than active Work Order evidence
Epoch becoming stale if main moves again
validation_plan: Compare the fresh branch against current main and require control-only paths.
Pin and review the historical scaffold source before transfer.
Run phase-independent harness tests before and after fresh R2 review/evidence records exist.
Prove historical R1 evidence is not part of active R2 authorization.
Run Status, Plan and Resume from clean Git-only recovery context.
Run standard and directional PC0 and require no blocking RED.
Require fresh exact-head Reviewer, Verifier and Evidence Map before checkpoint proposal.

notes: Historical epoch E2026-08-11-H0-0-R1 remains evidence-only and must not authorize this Work Order. The first implementation event must pin the exact historical scaffold source head before any capability transfer.
